title: Example: the panel reaches the game
do: Load a save and press Go to under this step. Link should land in the middle of Hyrule Field.
expect: The status line at the top shows HyruleField_Child and Link's position; Recent shows the go to.

title: Example: a step that must be played without a sword
do: Walk around; do not take the sword.
expect: Pressing the Kokiri Sword button asks first, because this step lists it in warn_buttons.

title: Example: watch a flag change
do: Open Story flags, tick 'changed while watching', then open a chest or talk to someone.
expect: The flags the game sets show at the top of 'What the game just changed' and are highlighted in the list.
